messages:
maya: FYI - after Saturday's model-serving deploy we see EU agg-hours for 'search_clicks' are ~4 hours behind. Console shows partial buckets + a bunch of 2026-03-18 window holes. Seems like late events, not ingestion. Can we coordinate a recompute backfill?

sam: Ack. Do we know scope? full-day or selective windows?

maya: Start with affected window 2026-03-18T02:00Z -> 2026-03-18T10:00Z, maybe just EU shards 4-7. Cost estimate?

lucy: Quick cost ballpark: per-shard recompute ~0.6 GPU-hr for that window (historical). For 4 shards ~2.4 GPU-hr + orchestration overhead. Add 20% buffer. Will bill to telemetry-recompute project.

ravi: Before we kick, confirm idempotency/dedupe: last run had partial duplicate joins that inflated uniques. Is the recompute workflow safe to re-run on overlapping ranges?

sam: Current recompute job supports upserts with tombstone dedupe if run with --idempotent true. But that mode disables streaming optimizations and is ~1.7x slower.

maya: We should avoid inflating uniques. Prefer idempotent run even if slower. We can scope small to start.

diego: If we're running idempotent, we can still parallelize by tenant-slice. Proposal: canary on low-volume tenant set (tenant=dev-*) across shards 6-7, then expand. Also set routing policy to prefer eu-dedicated nodes to limit cross-region egress.

sam: Sounds good. Ops console UX ask: can we get progress bars per-shard and a per-tenant delta preview before commit? That would help catch any uniqueness regressions.

lucy: We have a console card we can repurpose: shows bytes processed + tokenized rows. Will add a "preview diffs" button that runs a dry-run and shows top 10 keys changed. Low effort.

ravi: For safety, let's gate with automatic rollback policy: if uniques delta > +5% for core tenants, abort. Can we patch the backfill controller?

sam: Backfill controller already supports conditional commit hooks. I'll add a hook to compare sample metrics from the dry-run vs current and fail fast.

ops-bot: Incident runbook link: https://internal.redwood/devops/recompute-runbook — follow step 3 for idempotent flags and step 7 for rollback.

maya: Ok run plan: 1) canary idempotent run on tenants dev-* on shards 6-7 (eu) 2) dry-run preview + console diffs 3) if pass, expand to shards 4-7 with rate limit 0.5x 4) full commit with commit-hook thresholds.

diego: I'll open a console PR for the preview diffs + per-shard progress. ETA EOD.

sam: I'll patch controller to add delta-threshold hook and the eu-node routing override.

lucy: I'll attach cost estimate and update billing tag before run.

ravi: I'll run quick unit test for dedupe edge cases and sanity-check the dry-run sample keys.

maya: Thanks team — can we reconvene in #eng-platform in 30m for go/no-go? :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Scheduled run window suggested: 3772473600 (in 1.5h) — set if everyone is ready.

sam: Confirmed. Setting up canary job now.

diego: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pull/438 — small preview panel + per-shard progress.

maya: Thread closed when canary completes, we will post summary.
